dct_title_s: esripolorg92 - World Political Organization Membership - DBMS View
dct_description_sm: Abstract: World Political Organization Membership is a table with 14 attributes on membership of countries in world political organizations such as the Untied Nations and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). To display World Political Organization Membership attributes on a map, join this table to the World Countries 1998 or World Countries 1992 table using Fips_code or Abbrevname as the common field.
Purpose: Country membership in world political organizations.
